notes.subject: yu olgeta
notes.rationale: Ol i tokim yu olgeta — tok i go stret long man i ritim

notes.subject: המצפצפים / המהגים
notes.rationale: Hibru i mekim nois bilong pisin i singaut na man i waswas tok — onomatopoeia we Tok Pisin i makim olsem nupela nupela na waswas tok

notes.subject: הלוא
notes.rationale: Askim bilong Hibru — 'i notru lain i mas askim Elohim bilong en?' — sampla tanim tok i ridim olsem tok strong, sampla olsem askim

notes.subject: masalai
notes.rationale: הידענים em i 'man i save' — man i save toktok wantaim ol masalai; Tok Pisin i usim masalai bilong makim ol spirit

translation: Na sapos ol i tokim yu olgeta: Askim ol man i save toktok wantaim ol man i dai pinis, na ol man i save long ol masalai — ol i singaut nupela nupela na ol i waswas tok — i no tru, wanpela lain i mas askim long Elohim bilong en? Long bilong ol i stap yet, ol i ken go long ol man i dai pinis?

tokens.gloss: ol man i save toktok wantaim ol man i dai pinis
